verdict.rationale: smolagents agents run autonomously once invoked (agent.run()) and the memory tutorial explicitly notes you can run agents step-by-step for tool calls that take days, implying support for long-running executions, but there is no evidence of a scheduler, trigger system, daemon mode, or any built-in mechanism to set up and manage background automations outside of a running Python process. missing for 10: evidence of scheduling/cron-like triggers, persistent background job management, or hosted always-on execution.
